x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Never place native Git invocations inside PowerShell parenthesized expression lists.

x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Size archive-backed tracked-tree probes independently from metadata checks.

x1_operational.failed: The first full activation-blob display was truncated before the middle proposal inheritance was visible.

x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Use bounded windows for long committed batons and verify the final line.

x1_operational.failed: The first 140-line activation window still exceeded the display budget by a small amount.
x1_operational.recovery: Reduce the exact Git-blob windows to sixty lines and read every window through EOF.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Use conservative windows when individual lines contain long gate lists.

x1_operational.failed: The first filename-regex lookup did not resolve the installed Meta Tool Box skill.

x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Prefer exact directory-name discovery when a filename regex returns no match.

x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Never retry a timed-out Git mutation before proving its actual postcondition.

x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Keep route vocabulary searches phase-local and literal.

x1_operational.failed: The first narrowed route search referenced a nonexistent historical builder filename and returned no evidence.

x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not infer historical filename conventions across generator generations.

x1_operational.failed: The first combined builder patch used a Unicode-rendered context line that did not match and was rejected atomically before changing the file.

x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not retry a mutation until a non-stalling process check confirms quiescence.
